newsitem.title: UK: Standard Chartered up, bucks sector trend.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered up, bucks sector trend.

text.p: Shares in Asian specialist bank Standard Chartered advanced on Thursday against a weaker UK bank sector helped by a strong Hong Kong stock market and a broker's "buy' recommendation earlier this week.
The shares were 13p higher at 708p by 1456 GMT in volume of 3.1 million shares. They were the only shares in the sector to stray into positive territory.
Dealers said Panmure Gordon's change of stance on the stock, from a "hold' to a "buy' recommendation, had fuelled the rally.
The London-based Asian specialist bank also benefited from the Hang Seng's record levels this week.
Traders added that sentiment had also been buoyed after analysts at SBC Warburg upped their price target on international banking giant HSBC to 15.00 stg a share from 12.50 before.
"Any positive comment on HSBC usually filters through to Standard," one dealer said.
Shares in HSBC were down 5-1/2p at 12.51 stg.
